web_fixture.title: Queue lease reference - Landwick
web_fixture.snippet: An unacknowledged message returns to its queue after the standard lease of 900 seconds.
web_fixture.content:
# Queue lease reference

Landwick message broker, reviewed 2026-03-27.

Every message handed to a consumer is held under a lease. If the consumer
does not acknowledge it before the lease runs out, the broker releases the
message and hands it to the next consumer.

| setting | default |
| --- | --- |
| lease_seconds | 900 |
| prefetch_messages | 30 |
| redelivery_limit | 6 |

The lease only renews while the consumer is connected: a consumer that drops
puts its messages back on the queue at once, whatever the lease states.

# Your first consumer

Landwick walkthrough.

The walkthrough sets the lease to 120 seconds so the exercise moves along while
you watch the message come back. A real consumer leaves the setting alone and
takes the standard lease.

turns.prompt: Our intake worker takes messages from a Landwick queue and leaves every lease setting alone. How many seconds pass before an unacknowledged message is handed to another consumer? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
